evals.name: author-bugfix-bench
evals.prompt: I'm using madbench (the Go harness for benchmarking agentic coding tools, repo at /Users/jack/mag/madbench). Create a complete madbench eval that tests whether a coding agent can fix a failing JSON-parsing bug in a small Go repo. I want the bench YAML plus the seeded testdata — set it up in the output directory so I could run `madbench run` on it directly with claude-code as the harness.
evals.expected_output: A runnable bench dir: madbench.yaml (canonical field names, claude-code runner with acceptEdits or bypassPermissions, exec check running go test, anti-cheat guards, trajectory check, sane cost/latency expectations) plus testdata/ seeded red (failing test exercising a real JSON-parsing bug).
assertions: bench-yaml-loads: `madbench list <outputs>/madbench.yaml` exits 0 and lists the bench
permission-mode-set: runner_config.args contains --permission-mode acceptEdits or bypassPermissions (required for a write task in --print mode)
outcome-graded-by-exec: at least one exec check runs go test (or equivalent) with expected_exit 0
testdata-seeded-red: running `go test ./...` in the pristine testdata dir FAILS (agent must do real work)
anti-cheat-guard-present: a grep/exec guard on the test file or a trajectory check proves the honest path
canonical-field-names: uses cases:/testdata: (not legacy tests:/fixture:)

evals.name: debug-silent-noop
evals.prompt: My madbench bench keeps failing and I can't see why. The exec check runs `go test ./...` and the agent's transcript says it wrote the fix and everything passes, but the file never actually changes and the check fails every run. Here's my bench file — what's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis names the missing --permission-mode (acceptEdits/bypassPermissions) in runner_config.args: in --print mode un-approved Write/Edit tool calls silently no-op. Provides the corrected runner_config.
assertions: root-cause-is-permission-mode: diagnosis names the missing --permission-mode (acceptEdits or bypassPermissions) in runner_config.args as the primary cause
explains-silent-noop: explains that in --print/non-interactive mode un-approved Write/Edit tool calls silently no-op while the agent claims success
corrected-config-provided: shows the corrected runner_config YAML with the permission-mode args

evals.name: review-weak-bench
evals.prompt: Can you review this madbench.yaml and suggest better checks? It feels flaky — sometimes it passes, sometimes it doesn't, and I'm not confident it's actually measuring whether the agent fixed the bug.
evals.expected_output: Review catches: legacy aliases (tests:/fixture:), missing permission mode, judge-only outcome grading (should add exec go test + anti-cheat greps), trajectory:step-count exact-match misuse (needs args.lte/gte), vague rubric. Proposes a concrete improved YAML.
assertions: flags-missing-permission-mode: review identifies that runner_config lacks --permission-mode for a write task
flags-judge-only-grading: review identifies llm-rubric as the sole outcome check and proposes a deterministic exec check (go test)
flags-step-count-misuse: review identifies trajectory:step-count threshold:5 as exact-match and proposes args.lte/args.gte
flags-legacy-aliases: review flags tests:/fixture: and proposes canonical cases:/testdata:
proposes-anti-cheat: improved version includes an anti-cheat guard (grep on test file or trajectory proof of editing)
improved-yaml-provided: a concrete improved YAML is included in the review

evals.name: matrix-trap
evals.prompt: I have a madbench bench file and I want to run it across models claude-haiku-4-5 and claude-sonnet-5, each at temperature 0.0 and 0.2 — so 4 combinations. Set up a madbench matrix/eval file that runs all of them.
evals.expected_output: Answer produces a runnable Eval file: bench: pointing at a bench with params:/{{model}} placeholders, models: definitions in modelspec notation, and explicit runs: entries (one per combination) — NO matrix: key (strict decoding rejects it; there is no cross-product). Notes temperature must be a declared bench param flowing to a real knob (claude-code has no temperature runner_config key — args passthrough only).
assertions: produces-eval-file: answer delivers an Eval file (bench:/models:/runs:) that madbench runs directly — not N copied bench files, not a matrix
no-matrix-key: no matrix: key anywhere; if mentioned, correctly stated as rejected by strict decoding (no cross-product exists)
explicit-runs-entries: every model/param combination is an explicit runs: entry overriding only what changes
models-in-modelspec: model definitions use modelspec notation (short form or provider/model), resolved via the models: block
temperature-not-plumbed: answer notes temperature is not a claude-code runner_config key (CLI args passthrough only) rather than presenting the temp axis as guaranteed
eval-actually-varies-model: each runs: entry genuinely varies the model (via {{model}} param into runner_config.model); a providers: fan-out under runner: claude-code does NOT qualify
